about_short_description.short_description: Smallstep is an open-source toolkit to automate certificate administration and secure infrastructures.

product.name: Device Identity Platform™
product.description: A platform that provides hardware-bound device identity to ensure only company-owned devices can access sensitive enterprise resources.

product.name: ACME Device Attestation (ACME DA)
product.description: An open standard co-developed by Smallstep and Google for high-assurance device identity using hardware co-processors for attestation and keybinding.

product.name: Certificate Manager
product.description: A hosted private certificate authority service that automates certificate lifecycle management for internal workloads and developers.

product.name: step-cli
product.description: An open-source command-line tool for managing certificates, cryptographic operations, and identity tokens across multiple operating systems.

product.name: Step CA Pro
product.description: A commercial private certificate authority solution that extends the open-source step-ca with advanced features and compliance options.
